implementationDetails.htmlParsing: Regex token-based parser supporting quotes containing '>' characters, standard HTML entity decoding, and non-rendered metadata tag stripping (<head>, <meta>, <link>, <template>)
implementationDetails.cdpNormalization: Full support for CDP DOM.Node array attributes ['id', 'val', ...], DOM NamedNodeMap, and AXNode objects
implementationDetails.semanticPruning: Prunes meaningless layout tags (div, span, font without role/handler/tabindex/aria/data-test/text), hoists semantic children while preserving textual leaf nodes and landmark elements (p, header, footer, section, article)
implementationDetails.visibilityAndDisabledInheritance: Hierarchical state propagation ensuring children of hidden ancestors (display: none, visibility: hidden, hidden, aria-hidden) or disabled fieldsets are correctly evaluated as invisible/disabled with 0 score
implementationDetails.hiddenInputGuard: Strictly marks input[type='hidden'] as invisible, 0x0 bounding box, non-interactable with 0 score
implementationDetails.selectorEngine: Generates valid CSS selectors prioritizing #id, data-testid/data-test/data-cy/data-qa/data-action, name, aria-label, type, role, href, class, and tag fallback without synthetic fake IDs
implementationDetails.scoringEngine: Calculates interactive score [0, 100] factoring area, semantic roles, ARIA labels, visibility, and heavy deduction for disabled elements
implementationDetails.safeCenterGrounding: Calculates safe click center point with 15% optical inset margin and supports boundary clamping for human-like trajectory targets
